text:
maria: Heads-up — started seeing a wave of GPU node provisioning failures in ap-southeast after the driver 550 rollout. Lots of DKMS build errors on our custom kernels, nodes stuck at initramfs stage and never join the cluster.
infra-bot: [alert] 87 provisioning failures detected in ap-southeast-1 between 2071234500 and 2071234550. Autoscaler paused for that zone.
ryan: can you paste the dkms output? is it a compile failure or a modprobe issue?
maria: snippet from one failed node:
```shell
* dkms build -k 6.1.0-custom -m nvidia -v 550.XX
Error! Bad return status for module build on kernel: 6.1.0-custom (x86_64)
Consult /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.XX/build/make.log for more information.
make[2]: *** [scripts/Makefile.build:518: /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.XX/build/nvidia.ko] Error 1
modpost: WARNING: unresolved symbol: __tracepoint_sched_process_fork
```
ryan: that unresolved symbol smells like a kernel headers vs running kernel mismatch — possibly our custom backport not exposing the tracepoint. Were these nodes using the 6.1-proprietary AMI or the older 5.15 variant?
maria: apac on-demand fleet uses 6.1-custom (we backported a patch for SR-IOV). 5.15 fleet in us-west is fine.
cheng: aside — we also saw intermittent NCCL hangs from tasks running on nodes that did come up with 550 + CUDA12.2. Might be unrelated, but correlation with driver 550 is high. Repro: collective allreduce hangs after a few minutes, logs show nv_peer_mem registration errors.
henry: rolling back apac to 535 would reduce risk but capacity for 535-backed AMIs is limited there. If we pin to 535 we'd need to shift traffic across regions or wait for new spot capacity — can increase request latency and possibly cost by ~20%.
sara: short-term mitigation: add a bootstrap hook that skips DKMS and installs prebuilt kernel modules from our private S3 (we already build them daily for the main kernels). Example script:
```bash
# bootstrap snippet
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/nvidia-modules/550/${KERNEL_VER}/nvidia-modules.tgz /tmp/
tar -xzf /tmp/nvidia-modules.tgz -C /lib/modules/${KERNEL_VER}/
depmod -a
modprobe nvidia
```
This avoids building on-provision and sidesteps header mismatches.
ryan: add to that: cordon the failing node pool and set cluster-autoscaler exclude for ap-southeast temporary. I'll run cordon now and flip autoscaler to prefer us-west.
infra-bot: autoscaler policy updated — prefer-zones: [us-west-2, eu-west-1]; exclude-zone: ap-southeast-1 (temporary)
maria: thanks. Action items: (1) ryan cordon + autoscaler tweak (in flight), (2) sara prepare and push bootstrap S3 tarball for 6.1-custom and 5.15 AMIs, (3) henry evaluate capacity/cost for rolling rollback to 535 in apac, (4) cheng run NCCL repro on a staging 550 node to confirm nv_peer_mem trace.
henry: opened infra ticket INFRA-2198 with cost delta estimate. If rollback required, we'll need 48h to provision AMIs and test.
cheng: will run NCCL repro now and post logs to the ticket.
maria: also flagging product: this may briefly impact latency for routed inference traffic; adding a notice on status page if we need to switch capacity.
ryan: FYI — hotfix script looks safe but watch for module ABI mismatches. We should add a small smoke test: nvidia-smi & run a tiny NCCL ring on bootstrap.
sara: will add smoke test to bootstrap and validation hook.
maria: closing loop — tagging oncall for visibility @ryan and @henry, will update once rollback decision finalized. :eyes:
